summary: Tested lecture_complete bundle feature (scarcity endpoint + bundle orchestration code structure + landing band UI). 8/8 backend tests pass. Frontend band renders '12' dynamically via data-testid=scarcity-remaining. No blocking issues.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (~2443 lines). Consider extracting webhook handlers into services/ modules. Non-blocking but affects maintainability.

lecture_complete_bundle.py fires 5 asyncio.create_task without gathering results / retry logic — a failure in one child PDF is only logged, not surfaced in parent metadata. Consider recording per-child success/failure into md.bundle_children_status for admin visibility.
_current_lunar_cycle_bounds uses calendar month as proxy for lunar cycle (documented). If real lunar cycle alignment is ever required, this needs revision.
The scarcity endpoint runs on every homepage load without caching; if traffic grows, add a small TTL (e.g. 60s in-memory) to avoid a Supabase query per pageview.
seed_data_creation: None. Sold_out=true state was not simulated (would require inserting 12 lecture_complete paid tx rows in the current month; user explicitly said manual verification is acceptable). Conditional-branch code path was verified via source code inspection: Index.js line 220 `scarcity && scarcity.sold_out ? (...) : (...)` correctly renders the alternate 'Complet pour ce cycle · Prochaine ouverture le prochain cycle lunaire' string and omits data-testid=scarcity-remaining in that branch.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend GET /api/lecture-complete/scarcity returns {remaining:12, sold:0, quota:12, cycle_end:'2026-09-01T00:00:00+00:00', sold_out:false} (server clock is Aug 2026). Frontend landing band on / displays '12' via data-testid=scarcity-remaining. React.StrictMode is enabled → useEffect double-fires in dev, resulting in 2 GET calls per mount (network trace) — this is expected StrictMode behavior in dev, production build will fire once. Not a polling loop.
